response.title: which power stations can charge from solar and the wall at the same time
response.answer:
Several portable power stations support simultaneous solar and wall (AC) charging, meaning you can plug in solar panels and a household outlet at the same time to charge the battery faster.

This feature is commonly called AC + solar dual charging, hybrid charging, or multi-source charging.

One important distinction: some power stations accept both inputs simultaneously and combine their power, while others prioritize one input or limit the combined charging rate.
